example.title: John and Anna O'Sullivan Farmstead, shed 2

brief: Plain frame tool and implement shed about 18 ft by 28 ft, sided in narrow vertical boards with peeling white paint weathered to grey, with boarded-up window openings on the gable end and long side, exposed rafter tails under the eaves and a gable roof of rusty corrugated metal. Loose limestone blocks, a rusty wheelbarrow and a red implement sit against the wall; a big shade tree and the farmhouse just behind. (Small frame shed; nearest vocabulary type is frame_machine_shed.)
